texts.preamble: Satish Jaiswal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3 August, 2023 Author: Anuradha Shukla Bench: Anuradha Shukla In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Crr No. 3293 of 2023 (Satish Jaiswal Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) Dated : 03-08-2023 Shri A. K. Mishra - Advocate for the applicant. Shri R. G. Verma - Panel Lawyer for State. Heard on admission.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the trial Court has n o t properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record. For this reason, the citations in the cases of R. Jagdish Tea Company (M/s.) v. State of M.P. and another 2015 (1) MPWN 84 and Kiran Kumar v. State of M.P. 2006 (3) M.P.L.J. 171 cannot be applied here.
